notes.title: Playtest weekend, and soon Early Access release!
notes.notes:
Hi there! We're soon finally approaching release times for Worm Game! We're doing a Playtest every other weekend, plus another next weekend, and aiming for Early Access in November! 



All Steam wishlists are much needed and appreciated!



The first Playtest is live right now and will be going throughout this weekend! Got big updates this time, and would love it if any and all fellow readers of this post could test the game and give some feedback on Discord. Just head over to the Steam page[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2444930/WORM_GAME/"][/dynamiclink] and click the big Playtest button! (Also check the new video on the Steam page).

New in this playtest:

A ton of new and revamped levels! The levels are also divided into chapters (beware placeholder names). Story Mode now has 60 (of 66) levels ready, most of which are new.

Some revamped in-game UI and flow.

Crosshair cursor (as requested by many).

A bunch of music.



There's a bunch of new stuff coming up soon, and next weekend's Playtest will be focused on local co-op 🎮🎮
